name: Admin Diagnostic Attachment Management
description: Admin uploads, manages, and sends file attachments (PDF, Word, Excel, images) from the Documentos tab of the diagnostic edit page. Checkbox selection enables the send-to-client button. The send section also exposes a checkbox for the system-generated Acuerdo de Confidencialidad (when present) which is appended to the email as a watermarked draft. System-generated attachments (is_generated=true) cannot be deleted — DELETE returns HTTP 400; this backend protection is defensive only since the UI filters generated NDAs out of the deletable list.
knownGaps: is_generated delete-blocked branch is backend-only (UI offers no delete button for generated NDAs); covered by backend tests, not E2E.
